tasks.label: Dev: Start development
tasks.detail: Preserves .env, starts and waits for the backend, then readies the emulator and opens the latest desktop build without building Android.

tasks.label: Desktop: Rebuild and open
tasks.detail: Builds before opening a fresh desktop instance; it does not open a stale app when the build fails.

tasks.label: Android: Rebuild and open
tasks.detail: Requires explicit Android SDK license approval before starting the backend, building, readying the emulator, deploying, and opening the app.

tasks.label: Dev: Stop backend
tasks.detail: Stops backend containers while preserving data and caches; native apps and the emulator keep running.
